verdict.rationale: Summer Engine's own marketing says it is a full engine that includes physics for 2D and 3D games, so built-in physics is a first-party claim. That is the only mention, and nothing describes the specific capabilities the story names. missing for 10: documented rigid-body simulation, collision detection/response, raycast/query APIs, physics docs or reference pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a game developer, built-in physics — rigid bodies, collisions, raycasts — works out of the box

citations.quote: Describe the game you want and Summer builds it with you in a full engine: 2D and 3D, physics, animation and real gameplay.
